description: This file contains methods related to generating, compiling, sending, and cleaning up report chunks, as well as retrieving user reports and starting batch exports within the Mattermost server application.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing methods for report handling, user reporting, and job management.

methods.name: SaveReportChunk
methods.description: Saves a report chunk in the specified format, currently supporting CSV.

methods.name: saveCSVChunk
methods.description: Helper to save report data as a CSV chunk.

methods.name: CompileReportChunks
methods.description: Compiles multiple report chunks into a single file, supporting CSV format.

methods.name: compileCSVChunks
methods.description: Helper to compile CSV report chunks into one file.

methods.name: SendReportToUser
methods.description: Sends a generated report file to a user via direct message.

methods.name: cleanupCSVChunks
methods.description: Helper to delete CSV report chunk files.

methods.name: GetUsersForReporting
methods.description: Retrieves user reports based on filtering options.

methods.name: GetUserCountForReport
methods.description: Gets the count of users matching reporting criteria.

methods.name: StartUsersBatchExport
methods.description: Initiates a batch export of user data, creating a background job.

methods.name: checkForExistingJobs
methods.description: Checks for existing or pending jobs matching specific options to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: getTranslatedDateRange
methods.description: Translates a date range string into a localized description.

methods.name: GetPostsForReporting
methods.description: Retrieves posts for reporting, optionally including metadata.
